page.overview:
What is System i Leg?

The Town Plan originally consisted of the existing 700 series LEGO Mursten sets, several new HO scale accessories, and a vinyl play mat. Over the next several years the system was greatly expanded with both new building sets and many HO scale accessory sets, including the following:

The original Automatic Binding Bricks sets and then LEGO Mursten sets were continued to be manufactured under the System i Leg theme.

By 1966 the Town Plan sets were discontinued, and in 1970 the HO 1:87 Vehicles, the last remaining Town Plan component, was discontinued.
